environment.description: Deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with KEY_PROVIDER=hsm. The task ENI is attached to a subnet with a security group (sg-0a4f8e2c) that has egress rules limited to the CloudHSM cluster ENI (10.0.47.0/28 on port 2223) and the internal ALB (10.0.12.0/24 on port 443). No internet gateway route exists in the subnet route table. The container image is built with a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12) which does NOT include /bin/sh, /bin/bash, or the openssl binary — the PKCS#11 library (libcloudhsm_pkcs11.so) is the only crypto provider available. The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounted at /tmp with noexec flag. Additionally, the task has a custom seccomp profile that blocks execve for any path not matching /usr/bin/python3.11.

config.network_egress: sg-0a4f8e2c: allow 10.0.47.0/28:2223 (CloudHSM), 10.0.12.0/24:443 (internal ALB), deny all other
config.subnet_routing: no IGW, no NAT gateway in route table
